description: This Java source file defines the class DictionaryAddOnAndBuilder, which is responsible for constructing dictionary add-ons for the AnySoftKeyboard project. It manages different types of dictionaries, including binary and resource-based dictionaries, and provides methods to create auto-text and initial suggestions.

classes.name: DictionaryAddOnAndBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating dictionary add-ons, supporting both binary and resource-based dictionaries, along with auto-text and initial suggestions.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language code associated with this dictionary add-on.

methods.name: createDictionary
methods.description: Creates and returns a Dictionary instance, either binary or resource-based, depending on the resource ID.

methods.name: createAutoText
methods.description: Creates and returns an AutoText instance if available; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: createInitialSuggestions
methods.description: Returns a list of initial suggestions loaded from resources, or an empty list if none are specified.
